hints.title: Piece Relative Order Invariant
hints.text: Pieces 'L' and 'R' can never cross each other, so their sequence omitting blank spaces must be identical in both strings.

hints.title: Directional Movement Constraints
hints.text: Piece 'L' can only move leftward into spaces, so its starting index must be at least its target index.

hints.title: Right Piece Constraints
hints.text: Piece 'R' can only move rightward into spaces, so its starting index must be at most its target index.

hints.title: Two Pointers Matching Implementation

variables: n: length of start and target strings
complexity.notes: Single pass advancing two pointers through the strings.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all permutations of piece movement results in exponential branching.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Index pointers require O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that pieces cannot cross and verifies directional index monotonicity.
